exclude.why: White House: city is the District of Columbia

Washington Monument: city is the District of Columbia
Sistine Chapel: city is Vatican City

rows.label: Empire State Building
rows.description: skyscraper located in Midtown Manhattan, New York City, USA
rows.hook: was the world's tallest skyscraper for decades and is scaled by a giant ape in a classic film

rows.label: Eiffel Tower
rows.description: tower located on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France
rows.hook: is an iron lattice landmark built for a world's fair and nicknamed the Iron Lady

rows.label: Burj Khalifa
rows.description: skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
rows.hook: is the tallest man-made structure on Earth

rows.label: Statue of Liberty
rows.description: monument in New York
rows.hook: was a gift from a friendly nation and holds a torch aloft to welcome arriving immigrants

rows.label: Colosseum
rows.description: ancient Roman amphitheatre, a landmark of Rome, Italy
rows.hook: is an ancient arena where gladiators once fought

rows.label: Machu Picchu
rows.description: 15th-century Inca citadel in the Peruvian Andes and UNESCO World Heritage Site
rows.hook: is a mountaintop citadel of a lost empire, often reached by a famous multi-day trek

rows.label: Mount Rushmore
rows.description: mountain in South Dakota featuring a sculpture of four US presidents
rows.hook: has the carved granite faces of four presidents staring out over the Black Hills

rows.label: Stonehenge
rows.description: Neolithic henge monument in Amesbury, Wiltshire, England, UK
rows.hook: is a ring of giant standing stones aligned with the midsummer sunrise

rows.label: White House
rows.description: official residence and office of the President of the United States
rows.hook: is the home and office of the American president

rows.label: Hagia Sophia
rows.description: mosque, museum, and former church in Istanbul, Turkey
rows.hook: is a vast domed structure that has served as a church, a mosque and a museum

rows.label: Le Mont Saint-Michel
rows.description: French commune in the Manche department
rows.hook: is a tidal island crowned by an abbey, cut off by the sea at high tide

rows.label: Angkor Wat
rows.description: Hindu-Buddhist temple complex in Cambodia
rows.hook: is the world's largest religious monument and appears on a national flag

rows.label: Petronas Towers
rows.description: twin skyscrapers in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
rows.hook: were the world's tallest twin skyscrapers, linked by a sky bridge

rows.label: Christ the Redeemer
rows.description: colossal statue of Jesus in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
rows.hook: stands with arms outstretched on a granite peak above a carnival-famous city

rows.label: Mount Fuji
rows.description: volcano in Yamanashi and Shizuoka Prefectures, Japan
rows.hook: is a snow-capped, near-perfect volcanic cone and the highest peak of its nation

rows.label: Terracotta Army
rows.description: collection of ancient Chinese military statues
rows.hook: is thousands of life-size clay soldiers buried to guard an emperor's tomb

rows.label: Neuschwanstein Castle
rows.description: castle in Bavaria, Germany, Europe
rows.hook: is a hilltop fairytale fortress built for a reclusive king that inspired Disney's logo

rows.label: Arc de Triomphe
rows.description: triumphal arch in Paris
rows.hook: honors Napoleon's armies and sits at the center of a star-shaped traffic junction

rows.label: Golden Gate Bridge
rows.description: suspension bridge on the San Francisco Bay
rows.hook: is an orange-red suspension span often shrouded in fog

rows.label: Parthenon
rows.description: former temple of Athena on the Athenian Acropolis, Greece
rows.hook: is the marble temple to the goddess of wisdom on the Acropolis

rows.label: Palace of Versailles
rows.description: palace in Versailles, France and location of the Museum of the History of France
rows.hook: was the opulent royal residence of the Sun King, famed for its Hall of Mirrors

rows.label: St. Peter's Basilica
rows.description: church in Vatican City
rows.hook: is the largest church in Christendom, topped by a dome designed by Michelangelo

rows.label: Forbidden City
rows.description: Chinese imperial palace in Beijing
rows.hook: was the imperial home of Ming and Qing emperors, with a moat and thousands of rooms

rows.label: Tower of London
rows.description: castle in central London, United Kingdom
rows.hook: houses the crown jewels and was once a notorious royal prison

rows.label: Big Ben
rows.description: tower of the Palace of Westminster, London containing the bell Big Ben
rows.hook: is the famous clock that chimes beside the Houses of Parliament

rows.label: Buckingham Palace
rows.description: official London residence and principal workplace of the British monarch
rows.hook: is the monarch's city home, famous for guards in bearskin hats

rows.label: Leaning Tower of Pisa
rows.description: cathedral bell tower in Pisa, Italy
rows.hook: is a bell campanile that famously tilts because of soft ground

rows.label: London Eye
rows.description: observation wheel in London, England
rows.hook: is a giant observation wheel on the south bank of the Thames

rows.label: Taipei 101
rows.description: skyscraper located in Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan
rows.hook: was once the world's tallest skyscraper, shaped like stacked bamboo segments

rows.label: Notre-Dame de Paris
rows.description: cathedral in Paris
rows.hook: is the Gothic cathedral of Victor Hugo's hunchback

rows.label: Chichen Itza
rows.description: pre-Columbian Maya city in Mexico
rows.hook: is a Maya city with a stepped pyramid that casts a serpent shadow at the equinox

rows.label: Central Park
rows.description: public park at the center of Manhattan in New York City, New York, United States
rows.hook: is a huge green oasis amid skyscrapers, with a reservoir, a zoo and a famous skating rink

rows.label: Windsor Castle
rows.description: historic castle, royal residence at Windsor in Berkshire, England, UK
rows.hook: is the oldest and largest inhabited fortress in the world, a royal weekend home

rows.label: Brooklyn Bridge
rows.description: bridge in New York City, crossing the East River
rows.hook: is a granite-towered span with web-like steel cables linking Manhattan to a neighboring borough

rows.label: CN Tower
rows.description: communications and observation tower in Toronto, Canada
rows.hook: was the world's tallest freestanding structure for decades and has a glass floor

rows.label: Santorini
rows.description: Greek island in the Cyclades
rows.hook: is a volcanic island of whitewashed cliffside villages and blue-domed churches

rows.label: Hoover Dam
rows.description: hydroelectric dam on the Colorado River, United States
rows.hook: is an art-deco concrete barrier that tamed a mighty river and created Lake Mead

rows.label: Uluru
rows.description: large sandstone isolated mount in Australia
rows.hook: is a giant red monolith sacred to Aboriginal people, glowing at sunset

rows.label: Great Barrier Reef
rows.description: over 2300 km long coral reef off Australia's northeast coast, UNESCO World Heritage Site
rows.hook: is the largest coral system on Earth, visible from space

rows.label: Times Square
rows.description: neighborhood and square in Manhattan, New York City, United States
rows.hook: is the neon-lit crossroads where a glittering ball drops on New Year's Eve

rows.label: Trevi Fountain
rows.description: Baroque fountain in Rome, Italy
rows.hook: is where visitors toss a coin over the shoulder to guarantee a return trip

rows.label: Palace of Westminster
rows.description: meeting place of the Parliament of the United Kingdom, located in London, England, UK
rows.hook: is the Gothic Revival home of Britain's lawmakers

rows.label: Washington Monument
rows.description: obelisk on the National Mall in Washington, D.C.
rows.hook: is a tall white marble obelisk honoring the first president of America

rows.label: Brandenburg Gate
rows.description: triumphal arch in Berlin, Germany
rows.hook: is a columned neoclassical archway topped by a four-horse chariot

rows.label: Sydney Opera House
rows.description: multi-venue performing arts centre in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
rows.hook: is a performing-arts venue famed for white sail-like shells beside a harbour

rows.label: Sistine Chapel
rows.description: chapel in the Apostolic Palace, Vatican City
rows.hook: has a ceiling painted by Michelangelo and is where popes are elected

rows.label: Harmandir Sahib
rows.description: Sikh religious site in Amritsar, Punjab, India
rows.hook: is the golden temple at the heart of the Sikh faith

rows.label: The Shard
rows.description: skyscraper in London, England
rows.hook: is a pointed glass skyscraper that pierces the skyline of a capital on the Thames

rows.label: Tower Bridge
rows.description: bascule and suspension bridge in London
rows.hook: is a Victorian drawbridge with blue-painted twin towers, often confused with its plainer neighbor

rows.label: Milan Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral church of Milan, Italy
rows.hook: is a vast Gothic marble place of worship with thousands of statues and spires

rows.label: Kremlin
rows.description: fortified complex in Moscow, Russia
rows.hook: is a red-walled fortress complex with golden-domed cathedrals

rows.label: Alcatraz Island
rows.description: island in San Francisco, California, United States of America
rows.hook: was a notorious federal prison, once home to Al Capone, set in a chilly bay

rows.label: Giant's Causeway
rows.description: rock formation on the Antrim coast of Northern Ireland
rows.hook: is a coastline of thousands of interlocking hexagonal basalt columns

rows.label: Gateway Arch
rows.description: monument in St. Louis, Missouri
rows.hook: is a stainless-steel curve on the Mississippi riverbank, the tallest of its kind in the world

rows.label: Manneken Pis
rows.description: bronze sculpture and fountain by Jérôme Duquesnoy the Elder in Brussels, Belgium
rows.hook: is a small statue of a boy, dressed in costumes on special occasions, that spouts water

rows.label: Edinburgh Castle
rows.description: castle in Edinburgh, Scotland, UK
rows.hook: sits on a volcanic crag and fires a gun every day at one o'clock

rows.label: St. Basil's Cathedral
rows.description: church in Moscow
rows.hook: is a colorful onion-domed church ordered by Ivan the Terrible

rows.label: Space Needle
rows.description: observation tower in Seattle, Washington, United States
rows.hook: is a flying-saucer-topped observation spire built for a world's fair

rows.label: Hollywood Sign
rows.description: sign reading "HOLLYWOOD" located in Los Angeles, California, United States
rows.hook: is a set of giant white letters on a hillside overlooking the movie industry's home

rows.label: Marina Bay Sands
rows.description: integrated resort in Singapore
rows.hook: is a trio of towers topped by a ship-shaped sky park with an infinity pool

rows.label: Sultan Ahmed Mosque
rows.description: historic mosque located in Istanbul, Turkey, also known as Blue Mosque
rows.hook: is nicknamed for the blue tiles that cover its interior and is topped by six slender minarets

rows.label: Lincoln Memorial
rows.description: memorial in Washington, D.C., United States
rows.hook: honors a president with a giant seated marble statue at the western end of the National Mall

rows.label: Abu Simbel
rows.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in southern Egypt
rows.hook: is a pair of temples carved into a rock face, fronted by colossal seated statues of a pharaoh

rows.label: Cliffs of Moher
rows.description: cliffs in Western Ireland, on the Atlantic shore
rows.hook: plunges roughly 700 feet straight into the Atlantic along a windswept stretch of coast

rows.label: Sydney Harbour Bridge
rows.description: bridge crossing Sydney Harbour in Australia
rows.hook: is nicknamed the Coathanger because of its huge steel arch

rows.label: Red Square
rows.description: the main square in Moscow, Russia
rows.hook: sits beside the Kremlin walls, flanked by Saint Basil's Cathedral and Lenin's Mausoleum

rows.label: Lotus Temple
rows.description: Bahá'í House of Worship in Delhi, India

rows.label: Uffizi Gallery
rows.description: palace and art museum in Florence, Italy
rows.hook: holds a vast collection of Renaissance masterpieces that once belonged to the Medici family

rows.label: Fushimi Inari-taisha
rows.description: Shinto shrines in Kyoto, Japan
rows.hook: is famous for thousands of bright vermilion torii gates winding up a forested hillside

rows.label: Belém Tower
rows.description: fortified tower located in the civil parish of Santa Maria de Belém in the municipality of Lisbon, Portugal
rows.hook: is a fortress that served as a ceremonial gateway for explorers setting sail

rows.label: Ponte Vecchio
rows.description: bridge in Florence, Italy
rows.hook: is a medieval stone bridge lined with jewellers' shops and was spared destruction in World War II

rows.label: Charles Bridge
rows.description: bridge in Prague, Czech Republic
rows.hook: is a medieval stone crossing of the Vltava lined with statues of saints

rows.label: Museo del Prado
rows.description: Spanish national art museum in Madrid, Spain
rows.hook: is famed for its paintings by Goya and Velázquez, drawn from the old royal collection

rows.label: Hermitage Museum
rows.description: museum in Saint Petersburg, Russia
rows.hook: holds the largest collection of paintings in the world and began with a purchase by Catherine the Great

rows.label: Table Mountain
rows.description: mountain in Cape Town, South Africa
rows.hook: is a flat-topped peak overlooking its city, reached by a rotating cableway or a hike

rows.label: Atomium
rows.description: architectural landmark originally constructed as the centerpiece for Expo 58 in Brussels, Belgium

rows.label: Ha Long Bay
rows.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Vietnam
rows.hook: is dotted with thousands of limestone islets rising from emerald water
